original_sentence: But ultimately the chance to reduce overheads by employing fewer people or at lower rates will be what attracts big brands to technology.
translation: 但归根到底，通过雇用更少的人或以更低工资雇人来降低管理费用的机会，才会真正吸引大品牌采用技术。

key_vocabulary.usage_note: at lower rates 在本句中对应"以更低薪资"。
employ fewer people 在本句中对应"雇用更少的人"。
attract brands to technology 在本句中对应"吸引品牌采用技术"。
reduce overheads 在本句中对应"降低管理费用"。
